Definition: to quiver (with any violent emotion, especially anger or fear)
BiblicalUsage: 1) tremble, quake, rage, quiver, be agitated, be excited, be perturbed; 1a)(Qal) to quake, be disquieted, be excited, be perturbed; 1b) (Hiphil) to cause to quake, disquiet, enrage, disturb; 1c) (Hithpael) to excite oneself
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
